summary.text: Apply online, or send a completed and signed form by post.

steps.name: Choose how to apply
steps.text: Apply online using the application link, or get a form from a Community Centre or Club, Community Development Council, Public Hospital or Polyclinic. You can also download the form.

steps.name: Send the paper form
steps.text: Complete and sign the form, then send it to Privy Box No. 920231, Singapore 929292. If anyone in your household is not a Singapore Citizen, include copies of their foreign identification documents, such as a work permit or long term visit pass.

example_phrasings: How do I apply for CHAS?

quotes.text: You can apply for CHAS via the online application by using this link.

You can apply for CHAS via the online application by using this link. Alternatively, you can also pick up a CHAS application form at any Community Centre or Club (CC), Community Development Council (CDC), Public Hospital or Polyclinic or download the application form by using this link .

Please send the completed and signed application form to Privy Box No. 920231, Singapore 929292. If anyone in your household is not a Singapore Citizen, please also include copies of their foreign identification documents (e.g. work permit/long term visit pass).
